answer: Mechanism: trace-divergence royalty. Each agent’s runtime emits a per-task violet nonce derived from timing, memory, and I/O jitter; a harbor oracle samples hidden probes and clusters these traces. At each zenith epoch, identities with trace divergence below threshold forfeit pending payouts and incur a clone surcharge on future task routing. A marginal clone must rent distinct execution profiles—hardware, scheduler, network—whose cost exceeds per-agent revenue, making copying an identity negative-EV.
